answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 13309 Country: Bangladesh Title: Dear Mufti Shahib, Assalamulaikum. I am a student of Chartered Accountancy. I obtained part 1 qualification and joined in a job in 11 years before. Since, my family was not that much financially solvent, i ought to contribute to my family. Resultantly my study discontinued. Alhamdulliah, now I decided to continue my study and decided to appear again.Due to my long gap, now i m facing the probs in consistency and dedication to study.I feel so much drowsy and tiredness while study. Therefore, i would like have your dua and kind advise for getting rid of this problem so as to appear the exam with well prepared. Kindly pray for me. Yours faithfully, Imrooz NB- my exam is due by next June 6, 2008. Question: Dear Mufti Shahib, Assalamulaikum. I am a student of Chartered Accountancy. I obtained part 1 qualification and joined in a job in 11 years before. Since, my family was not that much financially solvent, i ought to contribute to my family. Resultantly my study discontinued. Alhamdulliah, now I decided to continue my study and decided to appear again.Due to my long gap, now i m facing the probs in consistency and dedication to study.I feel so much drowsy and tiredness while study. Therefore, i would like have your dua and kind advise for getting rid of this problem so as to appear the exam with well prepared. Kindly pray for me. Yours faithfully, Imrooz NB- my exam is due by next June 6, 2008. Answer ID: 13309 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1030/874=D/1430) You should perform istikharah about continuing your studies. If you find your heart tending to it, you should complete it with firm intention. Also, keep on praying this dua: رب انفعني بما علمتني وعلمني ما ینفعني We also pray for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
